name: @aiti-ai/pi-web-bridge
description: Bridge a [pi](https://pi.dev) TUI session to the browser with `/web` — the pi-web side opens the same session live, with bidirectional IO (prompt / steer / follow-up / abort / model switching), queued-message echo, and image attachment passthrough.
